instruction: I find it annoying when VLC automatically resizes the window to match the video dimensions. Could you help me disable the auto-resize feature so the window stays at a fixed size regardless of the video being played?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling auto-resize feature in VLC. The evaluator checks the qt-video-autoresize setting in VLC config file. Expected value is 0 (disabled). Default is 1 (enabled). Uses custom check_qt_video_autoresize__6947249d metric function.
metadata.verification: Created custom metric function check_qt_video_autoresize__6947249d that reads vlcrc file and verifies qt-video-autoresize=0. Default is 1 (auto-resize enabled), task requires changing to 0 (disabled).
